cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Admit I found the restaurant. You can keep credit for the whole holiday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You also complained about the menu.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Different claim. I'm not filing it today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. The rest of your glorious itinerary remains untouched.

mechanism: A treats its former travel-planning pupil concession of one restaurant discovery as sufficient, resisting a menu dispute without challenging overall holiday credit.
confusable: Not collecting every possible grievance: once B yields the bounded claim, A ends that dispute and preserves B larger success.
comparison: Ball-call correction versus contribution claim inside a holiday.
